gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme treated with temozolomide (200mg/m2) as monotherapy and patients with recurrent or progressive malignant glioma treated with temozolomide as monotherapy (200mg/m2).

gbm_population_flag.reason: Conditions field lists only 'Therapeutic Equivalency'; GBM is named in eligibility alongside recurrent malignant glioma and 'primary CNS malignancies'.

candidate_evidence.quote: Bioequivalence Study Between Temozolomide Oral Suspension (Ped-TMZ) and Temodal® Capsules

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme treated with temozolomide (200mg/m2) as monotherapy and patients with recurrent or progressive malignant glioma

role_evidence.quote: Ped-TMZ: Single oral administration on D1 or D2 according to randomization at the dose of 200 mg/m2.
[ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Temodal capsule: Single oral administration on D1 or D2 according to randomization at the dose of 200 mg/m2.

coder_notes: Bioequivalence crossover of a new temozolomide oral suspension versus Temodal capsules. Temozolomide is an established GBM therapy (D6); no candidate. Crossover design means each patient receives both formulations; Temodal is registered only as an arm label, not a separate intervention.
